const userId = $json.user_id;
const detailType = $json.detail_type;

// SQL для оценок ГДЕ ПОЛЬЗОВАТЕЛЬ - ОЦЕНИВАЕМЫЙ (subject)
const sqlAsSubject = `
  SELECT 
    'as_subject' as query_type,
    e.id as evaluation_id,
    e.subject_id,
    e.evaluator_id,
    e.calculated_score,
    e.updated_at,
    e.is_self_evaluation,
    e.evaluation_source,
    
    evaluator.full_name as evaluator_name,
    evaluator.role as evaluator_role,
    subject.full_name as subject_name,
    subject.job_title as subject_job_title,
    
    c.id as criteria_id,
    c.title as criteria_title,
    c.selfassesment,
    c.c_level_only,
    c.target_audience,
    
    es.score_value,
    es.comment
    
  FROM performance_db.evaluations e
  LEFT JOIN performance_db.users evaluator ON e.evaluator_id = evaluator.id
  LEFT JOIN performance_db.users subject ON e.subject_id = subject.id
  LEFT JOIN performance_db.evaluation_scores es ON e.id = es.evaluation_id
  LEFT JOIN performance_db.criteria c ON es.criteria_id = c.id
  
  WHERE e.subject_id = ${userId}
  ORDER BY e.updated_at DESC, c.id
`;

// SQL для оценок ГДЕ ПОЛЬЗОВАТЕЛЬ - ОЦЕНЩИК (evaluator)
const sqlAsEvaluator = `
  SELECT 
    'as_evaluator' as query_type,
    e.id as evaluation_id,
    e.subject_id,
    e.evaluator_id,
    e.calculated_score,
    e.updated_at,
    e.is_self_evaluation,
    e.evaluation_source,
    
    evaluator.full_name as evaluator_name,
    evaluator.role as evaluator_role,
    subject.full_name as subject_name,
    subject.job_title as subject_job_title,
    
    c.id as criteria_id,
    c.title as criteria_title,
    c.selfassesment,
    c.c_level_only,
    c.target_audience,
    
    es.score_value,
    es.comment
    
  FROM performance_db.evaluations e
  LEFT JOIN performance_db.users evaluator ON e.evaluator_id = evaluator.id
  LEFT JOIN performance_db.users subject ON e.subject_id = subject.id
  LEFT JOIN performance_db.evaluation_scores es ON e.id = es.evaluation_id
  LEFT JOIN performance_db.criteria c ON es.criteria_id = c.id
  
  WHERE e.evaluator_id = ${userId} AND e.is_self_evaluation = false
  ORDER BY e.updated_at DESC, c.id
`;

// Объединяем оба запроса
const sql = `(${sqlAsSubject}) UNION ALL (${sqlAsEvaluator})`;

return { json: { sql, detail_type: detailType } };
